    StartersDodos' last melonChilled watermelon wedges with feta, mint, lime and flaky saltHow to make it1.5kg watermelon, cut into wedges100g feta, crumbled1 handful mint leaves, torn1 lime1 tsp flaky sea saltCut the watermelon into thick wedges and chill well.Crumble the feta over, scatter mint, squeeze over the lime and finish with flaky salt. Serve very cold.Manny's campfire corn with herb butterCorn cobs charred over the coals, brushed with garlic and herb butterHow to make it4 corn cobs, husks on80g butter, soft1 garlic clove, crushed1 flat-leaf parsley1 limeSoak the corn in cold water for 15 minutes.Mash the butter with the garlic, chopped parsley, lime zest and a pinch of salt.Cook the corn in the husks over hot coals or a barbecue for 15 minutes, turning, until charred.Peel back the husks and brush the hot corn with the herb butter. Serve with lime wedges.Spiced roasted chestnutsSid, lord of the flame, lit these.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMammoth slow-cooked beef ribsShort ribs baked 4 hours in foil, then glazed with barbecue sauceHow to make it2kg beef short ribs1 tsp black pepper2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp salt150ml barbecue sauce1/4 cabbage, shredded3 tbsp mayonnaiseRub the ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika and wrap in foil.Bake at 150°C for 4 hours.Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.Shred the cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise for slaw.Sid's root vegetable and lentil stewSid, the sloth who eats plantsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Carrot, parsnip, pumpkin and brown lentils simmered with tomato, smoked paprika and thyme until thick, with crusty bread and a dollop of herby yoghurt.Soften 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves and 2 diced celery sticks in olive oil.Add 2 carrots, 1 parsnip and 500g pumpkin, all in chunks, with 1 tsp smoked paprika and thyme.Add 200g rinsed brown lentils, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 1 litre vegetable stock and simmer 35 minutes until thick.Stir in a handful of baby spinach.Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread.SweetsIce age coconut marshmallow cupcakesVanilla cupcakes covered in marshmallow and rolled in coconutHow to make it125g butter, softened150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour1 tsp vanilla extract200g marshmallows2 tbsp water100g desiccated coconutBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and vanilla and fold in the flour.Bake in a muffin tin at 180°C for 18 minutes. Cool.Melt the marshmallows with the water.Spread over the tops and roll in coconut so they look like snowballs.Scrat's chocolate hazelnut acornsDark chocolate truffles shaped like acorns, bottom half coated in hazelnutsHow to make it150ml thickened cream250g dark chocolate, chopped100g hazelnuts, toasted and chopped6 pretzel rodsHeat the cream and pour over the chocolate, then stir smooth.Chill for 3 hours.Roll into small ovals and coat the bottom half in hazelnuts.Push a short piece of pretzel rod in the top as the stalk.DrinksScrat's nutty caramel milkshakeVanilla ice cream, caramel and peanut butter blended with milkHow to make it600ml cold milk4 scoops of vanilla ice cream3 tbsp caramel sauce, plus extra to drizzle2 tbsp smooth peanut butterBlend the milk, ice cream, caramel and peanut butter until thick.Pour into glasses and drizzle a little extra caramel on top.Warm honey, lemon and gingerFor the long walk to Half Peak.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
